configuration.change: Contrast only: central Gaia smoothing 50 pc, low resolved grain, finite HERITAGE excess clouds and global display calibration.

oldSelection.densitySampling: Uniform random_index <100,000,000, approximately 5.52% of Gaia DR3; the spatial sample is complete to its declared random-index threshold.
oldSelection.pointSampling: All selected old members with G<18 within 20 degrees; no random-index cut.
oldSelection.selection: Published RGB and RC polygons; signed parallax/error <5 and conditional orthographic proper-motion ellipse chi-square <9.21.
oldSelection.limitations: CMD phase proxies are not exact ages. Crowding, extinction and the magnitude limit affect completeness. No survey hole is filled from the photo.

old.barDiscPartition: The measured old-star density is split into a radial-median disc and its positive inner excess, tapered from 3 to 4 kpc. Their sum is the measured density. No analytic ellipse defines the light.
old.color: Gaia Vega magnitudes converted to AB using ESA DR3 zero-point differences, then RP/G/BP mean flux-density ratios serve as broad R/G/B proxies. One grade per population accounts for the photo passbands. No individual stellar colors are fitted.
old.depth: Deterministic height draws from the adopted layer, preserving each measured sky direction. Individual distances remain conditional.
old.grain: Each population budget is divided between unresolved light and real Gaia points. The same intrinsic G budget is conserved at every resolved fraction.
old.dust: Molecular optical-depth budget is redistributed into the HERITAGE-modulated layer and globally normalized to Bell. Finite oval screens are omitted.
old.densityWeighting: Measured Gaia G flux. All bright members with G<18 are used; faint RGB/RC random-sample fluxes are expanded by 18.11709771 to their declared sampling probability. Gaussian sigma remains 100 pc. The count-only trial is preserved in round1.

completeness.method: Rathore/Olsen HST-tested crowding recovery for RC; Cantat-Gaudin parent selection for RGB. The union is corrected by individual inverse inclusion probability.

parentFunction.ordering: NESTED, ICRS, NUNIQ mixed orders, expanded exactly to order 10
parentFunction.scope: Parent Gaia catalogue with position and G, not the extra BP/RP or astrometry cuts.

crowding.rcSelection: Rathore Appendix A: full Gaia DR3, G 18.6–19.3, BP–RP 1.0–1.3, astrometric_excess_noise <0.2, parallax <0.1 and parallax/error <5, raw proper-motion circle radius 1.5 mas/yr, 10-degree footprint.
crowding.method: Gaussian local C* moments at the finest of 100, 200 or 400 pc reaching 30 effective stars. RC intrinsic sigma 0.04 is published. The other tracer intrinsic scatters are measured in 4–7 kpc outskirts. The same published recovery relation is applied as a tracer-dependent model.
crowding.limitations: The Olsen recovery curve is based on LMC-field-like artificial stars, including HST/WFPC2 images of NGC 1835. RGB application and coarser adaptive C* moments extend Rathore's RC implementation; they are explicit modeling choices. Unknown crowding cells use the parent catalogue selection only.

completeness.combination: The lower of parent catalogue inclusion and the crowding recovery estimate is used, avoiding an independence assumption and double multiplication. No completeness parameter is fitted to the photo.
completeness.sourceLimits: Rathore calibrates red-clump completeness. RGB extrapolation is an explicit alternative only. The parent Gaia function alone does not qualify extra CMD, BP/RP or proper-motion selection completeness.

old.preservation: Point positions, component assignments, colors relative to each population, adopted thicknesses, young density, catalogue objects, dust, plane and warp stay at l20. Point RGB is globally renormalized per old component to share the corrected smooth-light budget.

contrast.source: Identical l21 Gaia stars, G weights and inclusion probabilities; no image in density.

normalization.meaning: Same actual Earth rays through finite clouds and diffuse layer, projected to face-on equivalent with the retained inclination. One common scalar matches the Bell mean.

foreground.region: Only the measured HERITAGE pixels within 0.15 degree of catalogued 30 Doradus
foreground.assumptions: The paper supports foreground ordering there, not this 400 pc offset or our smaller circular footprint. The offset is an adopted representative placement. There is no measured whole-bar foreground offset, so no such offset is applied.

dust.source: l21 HERITAGE fine structure normalized to Bell, decomposed into nonnegative diffuse floor and positive fine excess at 5 arcmin. Source gaps retain the entire parent diffuse column.
dust.depth: Finite spherical cloud kernels have equal sky and line-of-sight widths, with deterministic draws from the adopted 250 pc centre-height prior. Each centre preserves its observed HERITAGE sky direction. Individual depths are assumed, never obtained from the photo. The diffuse remainder keeps the 250 pc Gaussian layer on the warp.
dust.geometry: No camera-facing opacity sheet and no Earth-direction columns. The same finite clouds attenuate all views.
dust.limits: HERITAGE gives a projected model dust column, not a measured depth map. The cloud prior preserves fine on-sky structure conditionally. Bell provides only the global column normalization.

details.acceptance: Five perpendicular profiles and dark-gap depth, bar color within 2%, coherent sides. RMS is reported, not a gate.
details.finalCorrection: Retain about ten percent resolved old light after the three-percent close-up became too smooth.
